system.description:
Contest: your Strength or Dexterity check (your choice) vs. target's Strength or Dexterity check (their choice). You win, they're knocked prone, no damage.

Combat Manoeuvres, Manoeuvre: replaces one attack.

Contest: both sides roll d20 + the stated attribute modifier; the higher total wins and ties go to the defender.

Target one creature and press Use: both sides roll, and the result is applied.
